race.comment: Bit of unknown to start the day with some first-starters from top stables matching it with a few who have already put some handy performances on the board. THE MINSTREL BOY (6) is a big market watch, being from the Clinton McDonald stable. Scratched from what looked a winnable race last weekend and has done enough at the trials to suggest he's got some talent. PEACE SEEKER (9) has race experience on her side and was good last start when beaten 1.5 lengths, which is the right form to be competitive here. BACK UP BARBIE (7) hasn't finished further back than fourth in three runs, which have been spread over three campaigns and this is the first of them in which she'll put together multiple runs, so maybe she's putting it all together now. SURHOMME (5) is a first-starter who showed good speed in a recent trial and while it was only a small field, he won easily and draws well. PIERRE LE QUILL (4) draws even better and can bounce off the best run of the prep last start.
